teachingQuestion: How do architecture layers and segmentation choices constrain network blast radius?
focalInsight: Physical, logical and workload controls can complement one another; no named boundary proves isolation without an enforced traffic policy and evidence.
title: Choose and test the network boundary
caption: These are complementary choices and assurance functions, not a mandatory five-layer implementation sequence.

nodes.label: Physical separation
nodes.definition: Separate media, paths or facilities can restrict connectivity; an air gap is a particular design, not a synonym for out-of-band management.
nodes.decision: Inventory all paths, including management, removable media and maintenance; verify intended disconnection.
nodes.failureExample: An air-gapped system receives a maintenance laptop that bridges networks.
nodes.detail: Separate media, paths or facilities can restrict connectivity; an air gap is a particular design, not a synonym for out-of-band management.

nodes.label: Logical boundaries
nodes.definition: VLANs, VRFs and VPNs create different logical separation or protected-path functions; configuration and interconnection determine reachability.
nodes.decision: Define source, destination, service and enforcement point; test allowed and denied crossings.
nodes.failureExample: Separate VLANs communicate unrestricted through an inter-VLAN router.
nodes.detail: VLANs, VRFs and VPNs create different logical separation or protected-path functions; configuration and interconnection determine reachability.

nodes.label: Workload policy
nodes.definition: Micro-segmentation applies granular policy between workloads or groups using distributed or other suitable enforcement.
nodes.decision: Map east-west dependencies and permitted services; test bypass, failure and policy-update behavior.
nodes.failureExample: A distributed firewall allows every workload to reach the database management port.
nodes.detail: Micro-segmentation applies granular policy between workloads or groups using distributed or other suitable enforcement.

nodes.label: Identity and policy planes
nodes.definition: Authenticated identity and context can inform authorization, while management/control planes distribute and administer policy.
nodes.decision: Protect privileged plane access and verify policy inputs and enforcement freshness.
nodes.failureExample: A compromised management account changes otherwise sound segmentation rules.
nodes.detail: Authenticated identity and context can inform authorization, while management/control planes distribute and administer policy.

nodes.label: Operation evidence
nodes.definition: Flow, capacity, fault and policy telemetry reveal whether the intended boundary operates under real conditions.
nodes.decision: Correlate allowed and denied traffic with policy and monitor bypass or drift.
nodes.failureExample: A firewall dashboard appears healthy while an alternate route bypasses inspection.
nodes.detail: Flow, capacity, fault and policy telemetry reveal whether the intended boundary operates under real conditions.
